Package neqsim.mcp.runners

Class McpAcceptanceFixtureCatalog

java.lang.Object
neqsim.mcp.runners.McpAcceptanceFixtureCatalog
public final class McpAcceptanceFixtureCatalog extends Object
Builds the public synthetic acceptance-fixture catalog for MCP campaign Phase 0.

The fixtures deliberately reuse the normal MCP runner inputs and canonical NeqSim process JSON. They are not a second simulator or an optimization benchmark. The catalog spans a single calculation, a small recycle train, a multi-area ProcessModel, and a generated 150+ unit recycle facility so later Phase 0 measurements can use stable, public, reproducible inputs.

    • largeFacilityInput

      public static String largeFacilityInput()
      Returns a deterministic 154-unit recycle process for MCP scale and payload baselining.

      The process uses only standard stream, mixer, heater, cooler, splitter, and recycle equipment. Seventy-five heater/cooler pairs make the fixture large without introducing owner-roadmap-specific optimization constraints or specialist physics. The final two-percent recycle closes through the first mixer.

      Returns:
      large canonical process JSON
